exposure: Positive feelings for and relation to the child
Partner's perceived relation to the child
Breastfeeding during the first two hours after birth
cohort: 324 first-time mothers were followed from childbirth.
finding: Mothers' enjoyment of breastfeeding and breastfeeding duration were positively correlated with each other, as well as with mothers' positive feelings towards their child, their partner's relationship with the child, their sense of coherence, and the strength of their parental couple's relationship.
